query_map.query: UPDATE app.policy_rules SET rule = '{rule}' WHERE id = '{id}'

REPLACE INTO app.log_audit (result, request_id, user_id, method, ip, category, message, request_body, response_body, status_code, user_agent, duration, created_at) VALUES ('Success', '{request_id}', (select id from app.admin order by 1 limit 1), 'POST', '{ip}', {category}, '{message}', '{request_body}', '{response_body}', 200, '{user_agent}', 0, '{created_at}')
INSERT INTO app.system_integrity_files (id, file_path, original_hash, update_hash, updated_at) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
UPDATE app.system_integrity_files SET update_hash = '{update_hash}', updated_at = '{updated_at}', last_error = '{last_error}', status = '{status}' WHERE `id` = '{id}'
